title: Meh
text: Meh. I returned these. They look good in the photo & are good quality but in reality did not work for what I needed - would be better to be used in a drawer not free standing.

product_metadata.title: ORGANIDY Wardrobe Clothes Organizer for Underwear - Closet Organizers and Storage, Storage Drawers, and Organizer Bins - 6 Grids for Bras, Socks, and Jeans - 11.8" x 14.2" x 7.9", Clear Mesh 2-Pack
features: KEEP A TIDY CLOSET: Folding and stacking clothing in your closet can make it look sloppy. Our closet storage device offers an easy and affordable way to make your closet look organized, even after you root around for the perfect outfit.

FIND CLOTHES EASILY: Stop tearing apart your bedroom for that specific pair of underwear or socks. ORGANIDY's clear closet organizer is made of breathable nylon mesh. It has six compartments to sort different types of clothing, including bras, underwear, children's clothing, and jeans or pants in small sizes.

EXPERTLY MADE: ORGANIDY's clothing organizer is made of durable materials and features thick edges to avoid damage. Our clothes organizer for folded clothes is small enough to fit in your closet and large enough to keep all your extra innerwear. The material is breathable and helps reduce odor.

SAVE SPACE: Our organizer is great for small spaces because it can be placed inside of closets or cabinets. Save time searching for the outfit you want with our clothes storage organizer. Storing clothing instead of hanging prevents it from falling on the ground or warping.

OUR STORY: As a mom of a 2-year-old, I usually choose jeans and a t-shirt to save time. After a while, I owned lots of clothing with nowhere to store it! I invented our clothes organizer for closet to store my apparel better. I hope to make other moms' lives easier with our closet shelf organizer.
